verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
YESU yajja alokole
Abalina-ebibi:
Naffe fenna aboonoonyi
Anaatusonyiwa.

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
Neeyanz(e)nno Yesu ku lw'okwagal(a) okunene,
Ne ndaba-essanyu lingi nnyo,
Kubanga ndokose.

verse.name: v3
verse.lines:
Tegwatuyiikira-omusaayi-
Ogusinga byonna?
Tewali gw'atayinza ye
Okulongoosa-ennyo.

verse.name: v4
verse.lines:
Neeyanz(e)nno Yesu ku lw'okwagal(a) okunene,
Ne ndaba-essanyu lingi nnyo,
Kubanga ndokose.

verse.name: v5
verse.lines:
Tetuyinza ffe-okwetuusa
Mu ggulu n'akamu:
Mu kifo-ekyo mulituuka
Abatuukirivu.

verse.name: v6
verse.lines:
Neeyanz(e)nno Yesu ku lw'okwagal(a) okunene,
Ne ndaba-essanyu lingi nnyo,
Kubanga ndokose.

verse.name: v7
verse.lines:
Naye bwe tumukkiriza
Katonda Kitaffe
Atulaba ng'abalina
Obutuukirivu.

verse.name: v8
verse.lines:
Neeyanz(e)nno Yesu ku lw'okwagal(a) okunene,
Ne ndaba-essanyu lingi nnyo,
Kubanga ndokose.

verse.name: v9
verse.lines:
Mukale mumukkirize
Muweebwe-obulamu:
Kubanga Yesu tagoba
Mu maaso ge n'omu.

verse.name: v10
verse.lines:
Neeyanz(e)nno Yesu ku lw'okwagal(a) okunene,
